title: atalk: Add support for MacIP packets
description:
Add support for decoding MacIP packets (IPv4 over DDP). Since these are straight IPv4 packets wrapped in a DDP header, pass them off to the IP dissector.

Additionally, add support for decoding ATP based MacIP configuration packets. These are easily detected as they are always transmitted over DDP port 72.

AI-Assisted: no
